title: Senior BMS Specialist, Global BMS Technical Services
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Global BMS Technical Services (GBTS) is Amazon's centralized Building Management System (BMS) technical support organization. GBTS operates within the Global Energy, Sustainability & Automation (GESA) division, which is part of OPS - GEMS (Global Engineering, Materials & Sustainability). OPS - GEMS is the enterprise responsible for driving engineering excellence, materials innovation, and sustainability initiatives across Amazon's global operations infrastructure.
  
  
OPS - GEMS leads the design, deployment, integration, and lifecycle management of building automation platforms, energy infrastructure, and sustainability technologies across Amazon's worldwide operations network. This includes HVAC sequence of operations, environmental controls, energy metering, power distribution, and carbon reduction strategies.
  
  
Within this mission, GBTS serves as the frontline technical arm. We ensure that every facility's BMS operates at peak performance while advancing Amazon's Climate Pledge commitment.
  
  
GBTS is a destination for engineers and technical professionals who excel in high-impact, operationally demanding environments. We operate at the intersection of building science, automation engineering, and sustainability, tackling complex technical challenges at scale.  
  
We foster an open and inclusive culture that values diverse perspectives and technical expertise. Our strength lies in deep cross-functional collaboration: controls engineers partnering with energy analysts, sustainability specialists aligning with program managers, and field technicians providing critical insights that shape platform architecture. We are committed to operational excellence, uphold the highest standards of safety and quality, and are driven by the understanding that the systems we design, build, and maintain directly enable Amazon to deliver on its commitment to customers and the planet.
  
  
Join us and be part of the team that powers, optimizes, and sustains Amazon's global operations infrastructure, ensuring every facility runs smarter, safer, and more sustainably.
  
  
Key job responsibilities  
We are seeking an experienced Senior Building Management System (BMS) Specialist to join an existing team that supports post-project activities across one of the largest BMS portfolios in the world. This role requires a dynamic individual with a strong technical foundation in BMS programming, HVAC controls, commissioning, and troubleshooting. The successful candidate will maintain, enhance, and optimize our global services, ensuring seamless BMS functionality and delivering unparalleled customer experiences.
  
  
1. Support the development and execution of a comprehensive strategy for maintaining, improving, and expanding our global support services
  
2. Collaborate closely with GRBD&E, D&C, Sustainability, RME, and other stakeholders to understand customer requirements, business objectives, and operational needs
  
3. Design, implement, and manage BMS standard operating procedures, policies, and processes that are scalable across the globe
  
4. Maintain and optimize BMS technologies, IoT platforms, and data analytics tools
  
5. Monitor and maintain ticket and work order queues, ensuring customer care and quality meet the high bar
  
6. Ensure compliance with change management processes
  
7. Monitor and analyze BMS data to proactively identify and action opportunities for optimization, energy efficiency, and cost savings
  
8. Establish and maintain strong relationships with internal stakeholders and vendors, ensuring a customer-centric approach
  
9. Provide strategic insights and recommendations to management on BMS trends, improvements, issues, root causes, team skillsets, industry best practices, and emerging technologies
  
10. Take ownership of BMS initiatives, develop technical documentation, manage timelines, and coordinate with stakeholders
  
11. Lead training sessions and development programs to continuously enhance the capabilities and technical skills of field RME teams and BMS Specialists
  
12. Drive a culture of innovation, continuous improvement, and knowledge sharing within the team
  
13. Willingness to work flexible shifts to provide 24/7 BMS support across global time zones

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in electrical or mechanical engineering, engineering technology or equivalent
* Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical/Electronics/Communications Engineering, Computer Science, or related field (or equivalent work experience)
* Experience in BMS programming, commissioning & troubleshooting
* Ability to integrate multiple communications protocols such as BACnet, LON, Modbus, and SNMP to a single platform with normalized data for standard visualization
* Ability to remotely troubleshoot BMS communication issues, including fieldbus (BACnet, LON, Modbus via RS485), Network Gateways and IP-based protocols (Niagara Fox, MQTT, BACnet/IP, Modbus TCP, SNMP)
* Deep understanding of HVAC, lighting, utilities, field devices, and other building systems, as well as energy management principles
* Exceptional interpersonal and communication skills to collaborate effectively with diverse stakeholders.
* Demonstrated ability to manage and prioritize initiatives in a dynamic environment
* Strong problem-solving skills with a strategic and innovative mindset
* Organized and self-motivated to take ownership of complex tasks
* Provide 24/7 BMS support through flexible shift coverage, ensuring global customers receive timely and reliable assistance

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience working in cross-regional BMS projects with multicultural teams
* Proficiency in cloud-based IoT platforms, data analytics, and visualization tools
* Certification in relevant programming languages or BMS systems
* Certification with Tridium Niagara
* Certification with Distech Controls
* Strong customer relationship management skills
* Experience and understanding of facility management and relevant electrical and mechanical aspects of BMS equipment
* Proficiency in additional spoken languages

title: Staff Detection & Response Engineer
description:
Fanatics Commerce is the global leader in licensed sports merchandise, operating a vertically integrated platform that designs, manufactures, and delivers officially licensed apparel, jerseys, headwear, and collectibles for major leagues, teams, and events worldwide. With more than 900 e-commerce sites and a global omnichannel presence across digital, in-venue, and retail, Fanatics Commerce reaches fans in over 180 countries and powers official fan experiences for many of the world's most iconic sports properties.

At Fanatics, we bring our BOLD Leadership Principles to life every day - building championship teams, obsessing over fans, acting with entrepreneurial speed, and delivering with a determined and relentless mindset.

**ROLE OVERVIEW**  
Fanatics is seeking an experienced Staff Security Engineer to join our Detection and Response team, bringing hands-on expertise in incident response, detection engineering, and SOAR development to help scale our security operations. The ideal candidate combines a defensive practitioner's mindset with deep knowledge of adversarial TTPs, driving continuous improvement across detections, automated workflows, and cross-team security partnerships. The Staff Security Engineer, Detection & Response delivers business and fan impact through BOLD leadership and execution excellence, leveraging data, automation, and AI-enabled insights.

**HOW WILL YOU DRIVE IMPACT**  
Success is measured by the ability to deliver results through BOLD capabilities and measurable outcomes.

Team & Leadership Impact (Build Championship Teams)

Provide technical input and direction on detection and response projects, including tasking, reviewing peer engineers' work, and mentoring team members to elevate the team's overall capability.  
Partner with leadership and peers to gather requirements, priorities, and enhancement requests, translating them into data, tooling, and integration requirements that align with organizational goals.  
Collaborate closely with engineering teams across the organization to continuously define use cases and requirements for enabling technologies including SIEM, SOAR, EDR, Intrusion Detection Systems, Secure Web Gateway, DNS security, System Hardening, Identity Management, and PKI.

Fan & Customer Impact (Obsessed with Fans)

Respond to security incidents and conduct thorough investigations, clearly articulating potential risks and remediation strategies to stakeholders at all levels to protect the platform and the fan experience.  
Apply a usable security philosophy — ensuring that security controls and processes protect Fanatics' fans and data without disrupting the pace of innovation that drives the business.  
Participate in an on-call rotation, monitoring the real-world performance of detections and automated workflows to ensure continuous coverage and rapid response.  
Communicate findings, risks, and recommendations with exceptional clarity to both technical and non-technical stakeholders across internal and external audiences.

Innovation & Problem Solving (Limitless Entrepreneurial Spirit)

Design, develop, test, and continuously optimize detection rules and SOAR workflows using engineering best practices, enabling faster anomaly identification and more consistent incident response at scale.  
Conduct proactive threat hunts and threat modeling exercises, drawing on attacker TTP insights to identify potential indicators of compromise and translate findings into actionable security controls.  
Evaluate and operationalize AI-assisted security tooling to expand detection coverage, increase response speed, and scale the team's capabilities as Fanatics continues to grow.  
Leverage detection-as-code methodologies and CI/CD tools (e.g. GitLab, GitHub) to manage and evolve the detection library in a disciplined, repeatable, and auditable manner.

Ownership & Execution (Determined & Relentless Mindset)

Own the full lifecycle of detections, automated response workflows, playbooks, integrations, and scripts — including authoring and maintaining thorough documentation for each.  
Contribute to process and technology improvement after each incident, ensuring the team learns, adapts, and raises its baseline after every event.  
Analyze endpoint, network, and application logs for anomalous activity at enterprise scale, applying strong data analysis and correlation skills to surface meaningful signals from noise.  
Operate effectively as an independent contributor within a highly distributed, multi-region SOC environment, demonstrating strong organizational skills, meticulous attention to detail, and the ability to prioritize work in a fast-paced, rapidly changing setting.

AI & DIGITAL CAPABILITY

We are building a future-ready organization. This role is expected to:

Apply AI and technology to improve efficiency, quality, and outcomes  
Use data and digital tools to inform decisions and enhance performance  
Demonstrate curiosity and adaptability in adopting new technologies and ways of working  
Contribute to a culture of innovation and continuous improvement

**CAPABILITIES & EXPERIENCE YOU BRING**

**Required Qualifications:**

8+ years of experience in technical information security roles with a focus on security monitoring, threat detection, and incident response, including hands-on incident response experience managing complex investigations with multiple stakeholders.  
Advanced experience with enterprise SIEM platforms, including the design and development of detections, reports, and dashboards, combined with strong SOAR development skills and proven experience automating security response workflows at enterprise scale.  
Deep working knowledge of adversary TTPs and demonstrated experience applying MITRE ATT&CK principles to detect and respond to security incidents, including use of penetration testing and ATT&CK framework tools to simulate adversarial behaviors.  
Strong conceptual knowledge of OS internals and malware functionality — including persistence mechanisms — sufficient to author endpoint detections directly from raw telemetry.  
Proficiency with scripting, REST APIs, query languages, and CI/CD tools (e.g. GitLab, GitHub) for automation, alert enrichment, detection development, and detection-as-code workflows.  
Experience evaluating and operating AI-assisted security tooling, and familiarity with working in hybrid environments that include both on-premise and cloud-based systems.  
Exceptional communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to objectively evaluate security risk and operate with a high degree of autonomy within a distributed, multi-region team.

*At Fanatics, we operate with a BOLD mindset - We Build Championship Teams, we're Obsessed with Fans, we embrace a Limitless Entrepreneurial Spirit, and we approach every challenge with a Determined and Relentless Mindset. If you're ready to contribute to a dynamic, fast-paced environment that thrives on collaboration and growth, we want you to be part of our team.*  
  
***ABOUT US***  
*Fanatics is building a leading global digital sports platform. We ignite the passions of global sports fans and maximize the presence and reach for our hundreds of sports partners globally by offering products and services across Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, and Fanatics Betting & Gaming, allowing sports fans to Buy, Collect, and Bet. Through the Fanatics platform, sports fans can buy licensed fan gear, jerseys, lifestyle and streetwear products, headwear, and hardgoods; collect physical and digital trading cards, sports memorabilia, and other digital assets; and bet as the company builds its Sportsbook and iGaming platform. Fanatics has an established database of over 100 million global sports fans; a global partner network with approximately 900 sports properties, including major national and international professional sports leagues, players associations, teams, colleges, college conferences and retail partners, 2,500 athletes and celebrities, and 200 exclusive athletes; and over 2,000 retail locations, including its Lids retail stores. Our more than 22,000 employees are committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience and delighting sports fans globally.*

***ABOUT THE TEAM***  
*Fanatics Commerce is a leading designer, manufacturer, and seller of licensed fan gear, jerseys, lifestyle and streetwear products, headwear, and hardgoods. It operates a vertically-integrated platform of digital and physical capabilities for leading sports leagues, teams, colleges, and associations globally – as well as its flagship site,* *www.fanatics.com**.*  
  
*Fanatics Commerce has a broad range of online, sports venue, and vertical apparel partnerships worldwide, including comprehensive partnerships with leading leagues, teams, colleges, and sports organizations across the world—including the NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL, MLS, Formula 1, and Australian Football League (AFL); the Dallas Cowboys, Golden State Warriors, Paris Saint-Germain, Chelsea FC, and Tokyo Giants; the University of Notre Dame, University of Alabama, and University of Texas; the International Olympic Committee (IOC), England Rugby, and the Union of European Football Associations (UEFA).*

* *Build Championship Teams*

We develop methodologies and craft tools to streamline the design/verification of NVIDIA's CPU and SOC designs. This position offers the opportunity to have real impact in a dynamic, technology-focused company impacting product lines ranging from consumer graphics to self-driving cars and the growing field of artificial intelligence. We have created a team of outstanding people stretching around the globe, whose mission is to push the frontiers of what is possible today and define the platform for the future of computing. * Improve continuous integration processes across multiple branches for various IP versions and projects.
* Continuous improvement of the speed of build and simulation flows.
* Set up automated metrics and dashboards to monitor health of the infrastructure flows and resources.
* Set up processes to identify suboptimal areas, and help in improving verification efficiency for the large team of HW engineers.

* Experience with setup, configuration, and maintenance of Jenkins build servers
* Background with Web development (HTML/JavaScript/REST) and databases

**Ways to stand out from the crowd:**

* A desire to constantly grow and learn new things. In this team you will constantly be exposed to new technologies and new problems. Your ability to assimilate new ideas and handle tough problems as they arise will be the key to your success.
* Exposure to RTL design/verification tools (VCS or equivalent simulation tools, debug tools like Verdi) and computer architecture
* Exposure to source control systems (Perforce/Git) and continuous integration systems (Jenkins)

title: Business Intelligence Engineer, Amazon Shipping
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Amazon’s global fulfillment network enables any merchant to ship items that are ordered on Amazon to any place on earth. There is a complex network of ways in which items move between vendor locations, Amazon warehouses, and customer locations as well as several intermediate locations through which packages travel before reaching the customer. With a scale of millions of packages, each with different attributes and delivery requirements, what results is a highly dense graph of nodes.  
  
We have built a highly respected BI and Data Engineering team which is focused on solving complex problems in worldwide transportation using workflows, optimization algorithms, and machine learning systems. These are large-scale distributed systems handling millions of packages being shipped through the Amazon logistics network.  
  
As a Business Intelligence Engineer, you will develop datasets, dashboards, reports, and visualizations using BI tools, and provide data-driven recommendations to support strategic planning within Amazon Shipping. Additionally, you will deliver across planned projects that will improve overall cost and profitability for the business.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Data Management and Integration: Collect, process, and manage large datasets from various sources, ensuring data accuracy, consistency, and accessibility.

  

* Data Analysis: Analyze complex data sets to identify trends, patterns, and insights that can inform business decisions.

  

* Reporting and Visualization: Develop and maintain dashboards, reports, and visualizations to present data insights in an understandable and actionable format.

  

* Stakeholder Collaboration: Work closely with stakeholders to understand their data needs, provide data-driven recommendations, and support strategic planning.

  

* Tool and Technology Utilization: Utilize and stay updated with the latest BI tools and technologies to enhance data analysis and reporting capabilities.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 2+ years of analyzing and interpreting data with Redshift, Oracle, NoSQL etc. experience
* Experience with data visualization using Tableau, Quicksight, or similar tools
* Experience with one or more industry analytics visualization tools (e.g. Excel, Tableau, QuickSight, MicroStrategy, PowerBI) and statistical methods (e.g. t-test, Chi-squared)
* Experience with scripting language (e.g., Python, Java, or R)

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Master's degree, or Advanced technical degree
* Knowledge of data modeling and data pipeline design
* Experience with statistical analysis, co-relation analysis
